repository.orgName: Ācārya Śrī Kailāsasāgarasūri Jñānamandir, Śrī Mahāvīra Jaina Ārādhanā Kendra, Koba (Gandhinagar, Gujarat)

summary.p: Multiple-text manuscript of two folios, written by a single hand in VS 1683 (1627 CE) at Pattana (Pāṭaṇ) and Muñjapura. Contains four works of the Pārśvacandra-gaccha milieu: (1) the Joga Batrīsī of Pārśvacandra, 32 verses (f. 1r–1v, line 1), copied at Pattana; (2) the Pañcaviṃśatikriyādvātriṃśikā-svādhyāya (Svādhyāya Batrīsī) of Samaracandra, disciple of Pārśvacandra, 32 verses (f. 1v–2r), copied at Muñjapura; (3) a Mahāvīra-vijñapti-stavana (f. 2r–2v), copied at Muñjapura; (4) a fourth work beginning kalakalā hīṇā mana tava sārā (f. 2v), breaking off after verse 4 at the end of the leaf: the manuscript is incomplete at the end (catalogued as naṭhī).
Witness A of the edition of the Joga Batrīsī (colophon title in witness N: Ātmajñāna-dvātriṃśikā). Only the first work is transcribed in full below.

supportDesc.foliation: Nāgarī foliation 1, 2 at the bottom right of each verso, by the scribe.

collation.desc: 2 folios = Texts 1–4. Foliated 1–2. Text 1 on f. 1r–1v (line 1), text 2 on f. 1v–2r (line 5), text 3 on f. 2r–2v (line 16), text 4 on f. 2v (lines 16–21), incomplete.

supportDesc.condition: Edges worn and chipped, small losses at the corners; text fully legible.

layoutDesc.layout: 21 lines per page (f. 2r: 19). Double red marginal rules on both sides. A blank square in the centre of each page (lines 9–13) imitates a string-hole space; no actual hole.

origin.origDate: Dated by the colophons of texts 1–3: VS 1683, Māgha śukla 5, Thursday (text 1), Māgha śukla 9, Monday (text 2) and Māgha śukla 1?, Wednesday (text 3) = January–February 1627 CE.
origin.origPlace: Pattana (Pāṭaṇ, North Gujarat) for text 1; Muñjapura (Munjpur, near Pāṭaṇ) for texts 2 and 3. Scribe: Kuṃyarajī Gaṇi.

encodingDesc.p: Diplomatic transcription in IAST following the TST conventions; the Devanāgarī view is generated from it. Independent vowels after a vowel (vowel hiatus, e.g. lābhaï = लाभइ, kahyaü = कह्यउ) are written with diaeresis (ï, ü), as distinct from the diphthongs ai/au (ै/ौ). Line breaks of the manuscript are marked with lb; the blank central square is not marked. Spaces added between words where possible; the scribe writes without word spaces. Daṇḍas and verse numbers as in the manuscript. Anusvāra is transcribed as written (ṃ), never normalised to a class nasal. The akṣaras ba and va are distinguished as written (???to be checked). Language of the verses: Old Gujarati / Maru-Gurjar, tagged provisionally as gu; rubrics and colophons in Sanskrit, tagged sa.

revisionDesc.change: First version: header and manuscript description (Corinna May Lhoir, with Claude).
Transcription of text 1 (f. 1r–1v) added in IAST; line breaks of f. 1r to be verified against the images.
